title: Let service steady your honor
summary: Let yourself be held close instead of measured by rank, performance, or proof. Let this stay near the next choice: let this stay with you: let the Beloved's way grow dearer than the mind's protest.
takeaway: Receive the dignity already being given.
lifeApplication: When pride starts arguing with the day, place a hand on the chest before the replay begins. Say, "I am Yours," and let the Beloved's way steady your honor.

source.shortMeaning: A servant's honor rests with the Master, not the room.
source.lifeApplication: When bruised pride flares, hand your honor back to the One you serve.
